tiers.name: Naive Parallel Independent MTP Heads (Materialize All D+1 Logits in HBM)
tiers.note: Materializes 4 x [32768, 151936] FP16/FP32 logits (39.8 GB) simultaneously -> OOM! Independent heads lack causal token conditioning (61.0% accept).

tiers.name: Sequential Causal MTP Chaining (Unshared LM Head & Unfused CE)
tiers.note: Conditions depth k on h_{k-1} + Emb(t_{i+k}), lifting accept rate to 86.5%, but unshared LM heads add 3.7B params and unfused CE holds 14.2 GB.

tiers.name: DeepSeek-V3 Causal MTP + Shared Emb/LM Head + Sequential Per-Depth CE Release
tiers.note: Shares Embedding & Output Head across PP/FSDP and frees each depth's logits immediately after backward before computing depth k+1 (3.2 GB).

tiers.name: Causal MTP + Shared Emb/Head + Fused Linear-CE (0.3 GB) + Eagle/MTP Tree SpecDecode
tiers.note: Fuses Linear + Cross-Entropy in 2048-token SRAM chunks (0.3 GB peak logits, 132.7x reduction) and runs 1-block MTP self-speculation (2.45x speedup).
